label: Jotform
description: Online form builder — read forms, questions, and submissions via the Jotform API.
notes: The AP piece ships no dedicated actions — only a generic custom-API-call action and a webhook trigger. Nodes below cover the HTTP surface demonstrated in the piece's common helpers (APIKEY header auth, GET /user/forms) plus the core documented read endpoints of Jotform's public API v1 (form, questions, submissions). AP auth includes a region selector (us/eu/hipaa) that switches the base host; simplified to the US endpoint api.jotform.com — EU (eu-api.jotform.com) and HIPAA (hipaa-api.jotform.com) accounts are not covered. Optional list query params (limit/offset/orderby/filter) were dropped because empty-string values are not documented as tolerated.
